title: Orders collected in the shop fail with a server error
rootCause: createOrder reads request.address.country behind a non-null assertion, but an order that is collected in the shop has no address, so it throws a TypeError. The country should come from the address when there is one and be the shop's own country when there is not.

symptoms.telemetry: error.captured events with the name TypeError and a message about reading 'country' of undefined, on /orders, each with an http.request for POST /orders that has status 500. Orders that carry an address are not affected.

report.text: I tried to order a teapot to collect from the shop and checkout just says something went wrong. If I type in an address it works, but I do not want it delivered.

failingTests: orders.test.ts > takes an order that is collected in the shop, which has no address
server.test.ts > lists a customer's orders in pages
server.test.ts > lists ten at a time when no page size is asked for
server.test.ts > makes an order for collection, which has no address, taxed as the shop's own country
server.test.ts > says what each listing returned, out of how many orders there are
server.test.ts > writes one event for each request it served, with the route and how it went
